API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPolicy ResourcesGet Destination Ip Groups Lite
Get Destination Ip Groups Lite
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ipDestinationGroups/lite

Retrieves the list of destination IP groups. This request retrieves basic information about the destination IP groups, ID, name, and type. For extensive details, use the GET /ipDestinationGroups request.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
type
string[]

Possible values: [DSTN_IP, DSTN_FQDN, DSTN_DOMAIN, DSTN_OTHER]

List of destination IP group types that must be included in the response.

excludeType
string

Possible values: [DSTN_IP, DSTN_FQDN, DSTN_DOMAIN, DSTN_OTHER]

Specifies the destination IP group type that must be excluded from the response.

includeURLCategory
boolean

Not applicable to Cloud & Branch Connector.

Default value: true
search
string

The search string used to match against the destination IP group parameters.

includeZscalerDomains
boolean

A Boolean field indicating whether or not to include the automatically generated Zscaler Domains group in the response.

page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 100.

Default value: 100
Responses
​
default

Default Response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int64

An ID that uniquely identifies an entity.

name
string

The name of the entity.

isNameL10nTag
boolean

Indicates whether the entity is localized for internationalization.

extensions
object
deleted
boolean

Indicates the deletion status of the entity.

externalId
string

The external ID of the entity.

associationTime
int32

The timestamp when the entity was linked or associated.

]
